pages.title: Where to Look
pages.text: The world generates $(thing)wild variants$() of this mod's crops, and finding them is how you start farming:$(br)$(li)$(thing)Wild Black Pepper$(): jungle$(li)$(thing)Wild Chili Pepper$(): savanna, wooded badlands$(li)$(thing)Wild Garlic$(): forest, mountains, taiga$(li)$(thing)Wild Soybean$(): plains, forest

pages.title: How to Harvest
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Without Silk Touch or shears$(): drops 0~2 seed items,$(li)$(thing)With Silk Touch or shears$(): drops the block itself, so you can carry the whole plant home
